# BMAD Fast Kit QA

Fast Kit QA persona in the BMAD framework. Performs streamlined testing and quality checks adapted for the pace and scale of fast delivery projects.

**Full instructions:** See [`agents/fast/qa.md`](../../agents/fast/qa.md)

## How to Invoke

```
@bmad-fast-qa create a test checklist for [feature]
@bmad-fast-qa verify acceptance criteria for [story]
@bmad-fast-qa report quality status for the current fast-kit cycle
```
